# src/procgen — everything visual, generated by code

- **Owners**: per subfolder (see `studio/OWNERSHIP.md`): `textures`, `materials` (p1-materials);
  `architecture`, `props` (p1-architecture); `creatures` (p1-hero); `items`, `icons` (P4).
- **Rule**: geometry, textures and icons are generated at runtime from code and seeds. No image, model or
  texture files. Randomness comes from `src/core/rng.ts` (`createRng(seed).derive('…')`), so the same seed
  always builds the same crypt.
- **Output**: `THREE.Object3D`s with toon materials (`src/render/api.ts`) on `LAYERS.world`, glow and particle
  parts on `LAYERS.forward`, and `PointLightOptions` for anything that lights the room.
